personal.name: Akash Kumar Gosain
personal.title: Software Engineer | Systems, Linux & AI | B.Tech CSE 2027
bio: Final-year B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at Silicon Institute of Technology, Sambalpur (CGPA 8.56/10). Based in Rourkela, Odisha.
My technical foundations include C/C++, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, computer networks, Linux and Android.

Led the integration of a multi-module speech and LLM assessment application at NIT Silchar. At NIT Jamshedpur, enabled 4B-parameter model inference on a free-tier 16 GB T4 GPU using 4-bit NF4 quantization.
Seeking associate software engineering opportunities across systems, applied AI and full-stack development.

experience.title: Summer Intern — AI Software Development
experience.description: Led the project team and integrated multiple modules into a speech/NLP/LLM viva assessment system. Implemented transcription, multilingual assessment, automated evaluation and personalized feedback workflows; built responsive student, faculty and admin interfaces for examination, monitoring and performance analytics using React.js, Node.js, MongoDB and REST APIs.

experience.title: Research Intern — Healthcare AI
experience.description: Enabled MedGemma-4B inference on a free-tier 16 GB T4 GPU using 4-bit NF4 quantization. Benchmarked it against five open-source vision-language models on VQA-RAD and SLAKE; measured accuracy, token-F1, latency in ms/question and peak GPU memory in a reproducible pipeline. Tools: Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT, bitsandbytes and Linux.
